work: Using the IUPAC convention DeltaU = q + w, heat entering the system is positive (q = +250 J) and expansion work done by the system on the surroundings is negative (w = -450 J). Therefore DeltaU = 250 - 450 = -200 J. The system gains 250 J by heating but loses 450 J as work, so the net internal energy falls by 200 J, matching choice C.
